test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

The poor woman is in excruciating mental anguish, and her loved ones appear to have assisted in exarcerbating her traumatic experiences.
solution:
The correct answer is '**exarcerbating**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**exarcerbating**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Exacerbating**'.
 
• **Exacerbating**: बिगाड़ना, making a problem, situation, or feeling worse or more severe.
